strings.zh: 西边　自行车道{NEWLINE}东边　寂静之桥{SCROLL}无论来自何方,{NEWLINE}大家都观赏到美景,{CLEAR}所以通过这扇大门的人{CLEAR}都面带笑容。{SCROLL}你也是吧！
strings.en: West to the Cycling Road.{NEWLINE}East to the Silence Bridge.{SCROLL}Coming from either way, everyone who{NEWLINE}comes through this gate has a smile on{CLEAR}their face from the beautiful scenery.{SCROLL}You’re no exception!
